job.title: Full Stack Developer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Full Stack Developer at Zoom, you will take end-to-end ownership of features and services that reach users worldwide, from design through deployment, monitoring, and production support. This role spans backend engineering, frontend development, and applied AI, offering you the chance to build meaningful, scalable solutions across the full technology stack. You will work with autonomy and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners who value craft, curiosity, and continuous improvement. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2–3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

You will join a team of engineers building systems that support Zoom's platform at scale, working across backend services, intelligent APIs, and AI-enabled workflows. The team values end-to-end ownership, technical rigor, and a collaborative approach to solving complex problems. You will partner closely with product, design, and infrastructure partners to ship features that make a real difference to how people connect and collaborate.


Responsibilities

  • Build scalable full stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, TypeScript), REST and GraphQL APIs, and relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Design and maintain robust backend services and APIs with a focus on performance, security, and long-term reliability.
  • Build and integrate AI and LLM-based solutions including AI agents, RAG pipelines, tool calling, and prompt-based workflows, with working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Own features from end to end, covering design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, and database layers.
  • Apply AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–8 years of software development experience with proven full stack expertise.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
  • Experience building frontend applications with React, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL databases, data modeling, and query optimization, plus familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, prompt engineering, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Practical experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, OAuth2, RBAC, and application security fundamentals.
  • Solid grasp of system design, distributed systems, scalability principles, and engineering best practices, with the ability to drive features independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

job.title: Audio AI Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As an Audio AI Engineer on Zoom's applied research team, you will advance the frontier of audio intelligence by developing and deploying machine-learning models that protect users from synthetic speech and audio deepfakes. Your work will have direct impact on platform trust and security, translating cutting-edge research into robust, production-ready systems. Each day brings a mix of independent experimentation, cross-functional collaboration with research, engineering, product, and security partners, and applied problem-solving at real-world scale. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our San Jose, California office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Zoom's AI Research and Engineering team operates at the intersection of innovation and product, building foundational capabilities that power Zoom Workplace experiences for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. The audio AI group is focused on speech intelligence, security, and trust, ensuring that voice and video communications remain authentic and protected as generative technologies evolve. Your contributions here influence the integrity of Zoom's platform and help shape the broader industry conversation around responsible AI.


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine-learning models for audio deepfake and synthetic speech detection.
  • Design training datasets, evaluation frameworks, and experimental pipelines for audio AI models.
  • Improve model accuracy and robustness across diverse speakers, languages, devices, codecs, and acoustic environments.
  • Analyze model failures and engineer solutions for reliable, real-world deployment.
  • Translate research prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with research, engineering, product, and security teams to align on priorities and ship impactful work.
  • Track and apply emerging developments in speech AI, generative audio, voice cloning, and deepfake detection.

What We're Looking For

  • PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Speech/Audio Processing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Research or industry experience in audio deepfake detection, synthetic speech detection, anti-spoofing, or speaker recognition; experience with generative audio, voice cloning, or adversarial machine learning is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of speech and audio signal processing, with familiarity with large-scale or multilingual audio datasets a plus.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, model evaluation, and experimental design.
  • Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow; experience deploying and optimizing ML models in production is a plus.
  • Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into practical, scalable solutions.

job.title: AI Scientist - Agentic Verticals
job.description:
AI Scientist - (AI Verticals)


What You Can Expect

In this role, you will tackle one of the most compelling challenges in production AI: enabling agents to continuously improve without compromising customer data privacy. You will own the development of synthetic data pipelines, advanced evaluation frameworks, and privacy-preserving feedback loops that drive measurable improvements in Zoom Virtual Agent performance, with your research shipping directly to production and serving real customers across Zoom’s growing portfolio of AI-powered products. As a part of the AI Verticals organization, you will operate with high autonomy in a fast-moving, research-to-production environment where innovations reach customers significantly faster than traditional research timelines.


This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence four (4) days per week at our San Jose, CA or Bellevue, WA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The AI Verticals team sits at the intersection of deep research and real-world production impact, advancing the intelligence and continuous improvement of Zoom’s AI agent products. Our work spans agent evaluation, model optimization, synthetic data generation, and self-improving systems, with direct influence on Zoom Virtual Agent and other products across the Zoom portfolio. The team operates a global development model with engineering partners across time zones, enabling research innovations to reach customers faster than traditional research organization timelines.


Responsibilities

  • Research and develop novel learning mechanisms that enable AI agents to continuously improve while adhering to customer data privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Develop synthetic data generation and simulation approaches that capture real production error patterns and customer behavior at scale, enabling model improvement through simulated scenarios.
  • Design advanced evaluation frameworks that go beyond traditional test sets and LLM-as-judge approaches, addressing how to assess and improve agent quality at scale without compromising customer data privacy.
  • Build scalable production feedback loops that leverage privacy-preserving signals and simulated scenarios to drive continuous improvements in agent performance.
  • Analyze customer needs and business outcomes, including resolution rate, escalation patterns, and conversation quality, to guide research priorities and deliver measurable improvements in agent performance.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy research innovations into production systems, balancing scientific rigor with practical engineering constraints.
  • Contribute to the research community by publishing findings on self-improving agents, synthetic data generation, and privacy-preserving learning techniques.

What We’re Looking For

  • Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with a research focus on autonomous agents, reinforcement learning, self-supervised learning, or LLM-based systems, or equivalent practical experience in these areas.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with large language models (LLMs) applied to agent systems or real-world production scenarios.
  • Strong foundation in machine learning and reinforcement learning, with demonstrated experience in self-improving systems, continual learning, or agents that learn from limited feedback.
  • Creative approach to evaluation challenges, with the ability to develop novel metrics and frameworks for agent quality in privacy-constrained environments, beyond standard test sets and LLM-as-judge methods.
  • Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or Java, with hands-on experience in AI frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate research innovations into production systems at scale, balancing scientific rigor with practical engineering timelines.
  • Intellectual curiosity, bias for action, and growth mindset, with the drive to take ownership of ambiguous, open-ended problems and deliver measurable customer impact.

The Retention Operations team is part of Zoom’s broader post-sales organization, which spans deployment, Customer Success, and Renewals across four global theaters, each led by geo-focused Renewals leaders. You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.

job.title: WebRTC Video Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a WebRTC Video Engineer on Zoom's real-time web media team, you will directly shape the video quality that millions of users depend on for clear, reliable communication. Working across the full media pipeline, from device capture and encoding through network transmission, decoding, and rendering, you will develop code to deliver the best video quality to the customers, diagnose and resolve complex quality issues across browsers, operating systems, and hardware environments. You will collaborate closely with global engineering teams to drive product development and release cycles. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Audio Video team is Zoom's technical foundation for real-time communication, owning the full media pipeline from device capture through processing, encoding, transmission, decoding, and rendering. The team delivers the audio and video experience across Zoom Workplace's native client, web-based client, and Video SDK, enabling developers and enterprise customers to build reliable, high-quality communication tools. By continuously advancing media quality and reliability, the team plays a central role in supporting Zoom's mission to keep people connected and productive.


Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain robust WebRTC media flows across web browsers, native clients, and media servers, including interoperability across these environments.
  • Develop and improve core modules for SDP negotiation, peer connection management, ICE/STUN/TURN, simulcast, packet switch architecture, and adaptive bitrate and congestion control.
  • Investigate and resolve audio/video quality issues, including codec compatibility for H.264, VP8/VP9, and AV1, hardware decoder edge cases, and browser-specific regressions.
  • Optimize end-to-end audio/video workflows across capture, encoding, transport, decoding, and rendering for conferencing use cases.
  • Monitor QoS performance, implement failover metrics, and analyze quality regressions using data-driven methods.
  • Ensure production stability through hotfix deployment, memory leak resolution, and proactive issue identification across production clusters.
  • Deliver US-facing technical support for enterprise SDK customers, covering requirements discussions, ticket investigation, troubleshooting, and integration guidance.
  • Build and maintain team knowledge bases, internal documentation, and best practices for WebRTC systems, and contribute to open-source communities such as Chromium and WebRTC upstream where applicable.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent experience, with 5 or more years of hands-on software engineering experience in real-time media or web communication systems.
  • Solid, production-proven WebRTC development experience, including real-world debugging, protocol-level issue resolution, and cross-browser compatibility work.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript for front-end media development, with strong debugging skills including packet-level analysis and use of media and protocol tooling.
  • Working knowledge of real-time media protocols, including ICE, STUN/TURN, DTLS/SRTP, RTP/RTCP, and SDP, with practical experience in SDP parsing, negotiation, and RFC compliance across browser environments.
  • Familiarity with video codec internals, particularly H.264 (including SPS/PPS, key frames, and hardware decoder compatibility), and awareness of VP8/VP9 and AV1.
  • Experience with simulcast, packet switch flows, or adaptive bitrate mechanisms in a media SDK or media server context.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve production issues, including hotfixes, memory leaks, and browser-specific regressions, with experience supporting enterprise SDK customers technically as a plus.

You will join a dynamic AI Infrastructure team focused on enabling high-performance AI across Zoom's products and services. The team builds the core systems that support model training, deployment, and inference at scale, driving innovation in areas such as real-time communication, computer vision, and natural language understanding.

You will build and optimize the inference systems that serve Zoom's AI models in production.   • Working knowledge of how LLM inference performs on GPUs: memory bandwidth, KV cache, batching, and communication across GPUs
